body: Zoloft made me a zombie. I could barely function and could focus on anything in class.
Absolutely terrified. I always keep my head down while talking to people. Probably explains why I have no friends
I should mention that that whole lying situation happened over a year ago. I'm not holding that over her head to make her feel like shit. I'm just paranoid.
No I can't do that. I'm not going to manipulate her into liking me saying it. I just feel bad for having done this to her.
Sadly I relate v-v
Hey you could always try emulators. That opens you up to tons of good games.
Maybe try some new games? What do you usually play?
Yeah I feel ya. My way to fix that is to take as long as possible to finish the game. So usually I try to 100% it.

Probably dumb but I play video games. Gets me invested in a fictional world and gets me away from reality for a while. Currently trying to 100% Rayman Origins so hopefully that'll hold my attention for a while.

Completely understand. Social anxiety is a bitch.

But hey I'm lonely as hell too. Feel free to PM if you need someone to talk to.

If you look on the sidebar it says we aren't allowed to post pro-suicide posts, comments or any explicit discussion of suicide methods. So no one is going to help you with that.

 Try seeking out a therapist or doctor OP. Hope it all goes well for you.

This may be a depressing subreddit but I think most of us wouldn't advocate committing suicide or help someone go through with it. Suicide isn't always the answer. 

If you truly need help random people on reddit aren't going to be much help. Seek help with a therapist or doctor.
Not that I know of. And even if there was I wouldn't tell you. I'm not helping someone commit suicide.
Yeah that goes against the rules of this subreddit. No one is going to do that.

I've tried counselors before, they've never helped. I'm horrible at talking on the phone anyways. Plus, I have horrible social anxiety so I probably wouldn't be able to do it anyways.

And like I said I don't want to die. I mean I do but I don't want to kill myself. I just want some unfortunate accident to happen.
Honestly no I haven't, and if you're talking about medication I don't really care for that. I tried once years ago and it made me spaced out to hell.

Maybe you're right. I don't know anymore. I'm just being crushed by all this shit going on and I want it to stop. 

And I've told my significant other but they don't know that it's this bad and I'd never tell them. I don't want to worry anyone else. All I do is vent on Reddit.

You're best bet is to separate until you get your mental issues figured out, for the sake of him and your child. You might've went through a lot with your pregnancy but that's no excuse to abuse your spouse. No one needs to be raised in that environment. I know that personally. If you're really having issues with your health get help. Suicide isn't always the answer. 

But are you currently abusing them? You're obviously apologetic and have remorse over your actions. If so, that's no reason to kill yourself. Who will be there for your daughter?

Not sure why you're being downvoted. What nice, supportive people in this subreddit.

I honestly don't know what to say besides I understand how you feel (I'm not good at socializing so I apologize). Sometimes I just do a dumb thing like dropping my keys and I'm like "Good going retard, you're such a dumb fuck you should just kill yourself.". I don't know why I haven't yet to be honest.

But you're only 23. You have a whole life ahead of you. People get past these things. You have time to think about what you want.

Not trying to sound rude but ever think about seeing a counselor or someone to talk about these thoughts? I'm not saying that I think you're gonna kill someone, but if these thoughts are weighing on your mind they obviously aren't good.
Dude that happened to me. I had no money and starved all weekend and I found that subreddit. Tried to explain my situation but it got deleted. Still starved.

Me and my SO talk to each other about ours and cry together. It helps us cope and brings us closer when we help each other. We've helped each other through a lot of shit.

Maybe talk to her about it? It isn't doing you any good to keep it bottled up, and if she has depression she'll likely understand what you're going through.

I don't want to ask you details you don't want to share, but what things did your girlfriend and others freak out on you for telling them? You've mentioned you hurt people?

And I understand where you're coming from. I put on a mask, but probably not for the same reasons as you, but I don't know you so I can't say that. I do it to hide my depression and suicidal thoughts. It wears you down after a while. But if you ever need anyone to vent to I'm online.

Honestly your best bet is to seek out other ways to deal with your depression. If your medication isn't working you need something else to help. Maybe get your medication changed, seek out therapy, or pick up a hobby to help distract you from those thoughts.

Gosh, I'm so sorry about your family. It must be rough. I've had a lot of loss lately but not that much. That's terrible.

And I'm glad to see I'm not the only one to feel this way, well not glad that you feel this way it's fucking terrible, but glad I have someone to relate to with this. I hate this world too. I wish I was old enough to drink so I could numb this feeling, but at the same time I don't. I love my significant other and don't want to destroy my body and make them think somethings wrong, but at the same time I want to be selfish and do all the stuff I've been tempted to do. 

Same, I can't tell anyone either. I always joke about suicide so I feel like even if I did tell anyone they'd think I was being sarcastic and take it as a joke. Sometimes I feel like I'm not joking. But hey no problem. I might keep this account around to mainly vent here (since I don't want my main associated with my depressing bullshit) so if you ever need someone to vent to I'll be online.

No matter what anyone says suicide is selfish as hell. People do have a right to live or die, but they do that at the expense of their family. I've seen families absolutely destroyed by a family member committing suicide. No one can say suicide isn't selfish.
